evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep began logistics probing immediately ('do we have a unit number').
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Gave hourly rate ($208 for two movers, one truck) but no typical range for a move of this size before personalizing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer.

evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: 'if we can't making the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' — covers discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: 'no worries, damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate' and '$2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' — covers $2k and built-in framing.

evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: 'Do you have any other questions for me?' — empty throwaway, not genuine 'what's still concerning you.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep said 'I'm going to email this over to you right now' and 'we will see you on Thursday, October 1st' (assumed yes, no explicit ask).
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (October 1st), phone, and crew size (2 movers, 1 truck) confirmed. Arrival window (4-5 hours) discussed but not a precise time window. Addresses pulled from system at start. Notes left for crew (COI check, extra boxes). Missing explicit confirmation of addresses at end and no re-read of key details.

top_strength: Brianne gathered extensive logistics details efficiently—property type, floor/stories, box count, elevator reservations, loading dock access, walking distance—and used them to personalize the estimate and flag potential issues (elevator adds time) before pricing.
coaching_note: Section 1 is missing the critical time-box + dependable-quote framing and explicit wait-for-yes; Section 2 skipped Their Agenda entirely (no 'what are your biggest concerns' question); Section 7 never asked the explicit close ('Would you like our help?')—these are load-bearing asks in the script and must happen in sequence.
booking_note: Customer explicitly confirmed the move for Thursday, October 1st with time window 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM. Agent stated 'we will see you on Thursday, October 1st' and customer agreed 'Sure, yeah, thank you so much.'
